versos.grego: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν [ἐν Ἐφέσῳ] καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God,   to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:
controles.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus pela vontade de Deus, aos santos que estão em Éfeso, e fiéis em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Graça e paz, de Deus nosso Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, sejam convosco.

versos.grego: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ,

controles.web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;
controles.kjv: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ:
controles.livre: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que nos abençoou com todas as bênçãos espirituis nos lugares celestiais em Cristo.

versos.grego: καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ, ἐν ἀγάπῃ

controles.web: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love;
controles.kjv: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
controles.livre: Assim como nos escolheu nele antes da fundação do mundo, para que fôssemos santos e irrepreensíveis diante dele em amor.

versos.grego: προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
controles.kjv: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
controles.livre: E nos predestinou como filhos adotados por meio de Jesus Cristo para si mesmo, conforme o bom prazer de sua vontade;

versos.grego: εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ Ἠγαπημένῳ,

controles.web: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,
controles.kjv: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.
controles.livre: para louvor da glória de sua graça, a qual nos concedeu gratuitamente  no Amado.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ

controles.web: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,
controles.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
controles.livre: Nele temos a libertação  pelo seu sangue, o perdão dos pecados, conforme as riquezas da sua graça,

versos.grego: ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει

controles.web: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
controles.kjv: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
controles.livre: que ele fez transbordar em nós em toda sabedoria e prudência.

versos.grego: γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ, ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ

controles.web: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
controles.kjv: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself:
controles.livre: E nos revelou o mistério da sua vontade, conforme o seu bom prazer, que propôs nele,

versos.grego: εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐν αὐτῷ,

controles.web: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;
controles.kjv: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
controles.livre: para a administração do cumprimento dos tempos, isto é, voltar a reunir todas as coisas em Cristo, tanto as que estão nos céus, quanto as que estão na terra.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;
controles.kjv: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will:
controles.livre: Nele também fomos feitos herança, havendo sido predestinados conforme o propósito daquele que faz todas as coisas segundo o conselho da sua vontade,

versos.grego: εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·

controles.web: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:
controles.kjv: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ.
controles.livre: para que fôssemos para louvor da sua glória, nós os que primeiro esperamos em Cristo.

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς, ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ Πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ Ἁγίῳ,

controles.web: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,
controles.kjv: In whom ye also trusted, after that ye heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that ye believed, ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
controles.livre: E também vós, depois que ouvistes a palavra da verdade, o evangelho da vossa salvação, e nele crestes, nele fostes selados com o Espírito Santo da promessa,

versos.grego: ὅς ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.
controles.kjv: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
controles.livre: que é a garantia da nossa herança, até a libertação  da propriedade de Deus , para louvor da sua glória.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθ’ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους,

controles.web: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,
controles.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
controles.livre: Por isso eu, desde que ouvi da fé que há entre vós no Senhor Jesus, e do amor a todos os santos,

versos.grego: οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου,

controles.web: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
controles.kjv: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
controles.livre: não paro de agradecer a Deus por vós, lembrando-me em minhas orações.

versos.grego: ἵνα ὁ Θεὸς τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ Πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
controles.kjv: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
controles.livre: Oro para que o Deus de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Pai glorioso  , vos dê o Espírito de sabedoria e de revelação no conhecimento dele;

versos.grego: πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν, εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις,

controles.web: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
controles.kjv: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that ye may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
controles.livre: e que sejam iluminados os olhos do vosso coração, para que conheçais qual é a esperança para a qual ele chamou, quais são as riquezas da gloriosa herança  dele nos santos,

versos.grego: καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
controles.kjv: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
controles.livre: e qual é a superabundante grandeza do seu poder para nós, que cremos, conforme a operação da sua poderosa força,

versos.grego: ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις

controles.web: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
controles.kjv: Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
controles.livre: a qual ele operou em Cristo, ressuscitando-o dos mortos; e o colocou à direita dele nos céus,

versos.grego: ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι·

controles.web: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
controles.kjv: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
controles.livre: acima de todo governo, autoridade, poder, domínio, e de todo nome que se nomeia, não só nesta era, mas também na futura.

versos.grego: καὶ πάντα ὑπέταξεν ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτὸν ἔδωκεν κεφαλὴν ὑπὲρ πάντα τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ,

controles.web: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
controles.kjv: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
controles.livre: Ele também sujeitou todas as coisas debaixo dos seus pés, e o constituiu por cabeça sobre todas as coisas para a Igreja,

versos.grego: ἥτις ἐστὶν τὸ σῶμα αὐτοῦ, τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐν πᾶσιν πληρουμένου.

controles.web: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
controles.kjv: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
controles.livre: que é o seu corpo, a plenitude daquele que enche tudo em todas as coisas.
